notes: Replace the example case command with your actual driver CLI before running.
Each command must perform one complete sender/receiver transfer and exit.
The final stdout line may be a JSON object with metrics: packets_sent, retransmissions, timeouts, integrity_ok, goodput_bytes_per_second.
If sender and receiver are separate processes, create a wrapper script that starts the receiver, runs the sender, waits for both, verifies the received file hash, and prints one JSON metrics line.
